title: useMatches
summary: Read the active flat route’s identifier, data, and parameters.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no arguments. Requires the application context provided by RouterApplication or mountApplication, in addition to a router.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns a one-element array containing { id, data, params } for the current snapshot. The ID is the manifest route ID, or an empty string when the route has none. The root module is not an additional match, and this API does not produce a nested layout ancestry.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Use a route ID to identify the active page. Use useLoaderData for inferred data from the current loader, or useRouteLoaderData for a specific active ID.

sections.title: Flat routes and missing matches
sections.body: File names may encode URL segments, but the matcher remains flat. Even when no route matches, the result contains the current snapshot with an empty ID. Do not treat array length as proof that a page matched.
